_comment: What the deployment requires of a client, per store. Published by seed-release.mjs.
`minimum` is the oldest build still allowed to run, as a major.minor.patch version — the
same string as bundleVersion in Player Settings. A build equal to it is allowed; anything
older meets the wall. "0.0.0" means nothing is forced, which is the ordinary state and the
Raise a platform's minimum only once that platform's store is actually serving the build,
which is the whole reason these are separate: Apple review runs days behind a Play rollout,
so the normal state of a release is Android raised and iOS still at the old number.
`store` is where a walled player is sent. It must be https — a scheme link that the device
cannot claim opens nothing at all, which is a dead button on a panel that has only the one.
A platform with a minimum and no store link is refused by the tool and ignored by the
client: a wall with no door cannot be opened from the player's side by any build.
To lift every wall in the world: set both minimums back to "0.0.0" and re-publish, or
delete config/release outright. Either reaches a stuck device on its next check.

ios._store: The numeric Apple id is minted by App Store Connect and is derivable from nothing in the build, so it is typed once here. The link 404s in a browser until the listing is public, which does not matter: it is only ever opened by a player who has met a wall, and a wall is only raised once Apple is serving the build.
